description:
Query gene dependencies for a specific cell line.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_essentiality_screens — one record = one DepMap CRISPR screen result of one gene in one cell line (grouped by tissue).
Key: id, geneEssentiality[].depMapEssentiality[].tissueId, geneEssentiality[].depMapEssentiality[].screens[].depmapId.
Arguments: cell_line_name accepts depmap cell line (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by geneEssentiality[].depMapEssentiality[].screens[].geneEffect asc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one DepMap CRISPR screen result of one gene in one cell line (grouped by tissue)); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.cell_line` counts cell_lines.
Rows with unknown geneEffect are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Cutoff: dependency = geneEffect ≤ -0.5, inclusive.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. DepMap CRISPR screens of cancer cell lines only; a missing gene or line means not screened.

cell_line_name.description: Accepts depmap_cell_line; resolved to one depmap_cell_line (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

min_effect_threshold.description: Keeps rows with geneEssentiality[].depMapEssentiality[].screens[].geneEffect <= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to -0.5; pass null for no restriction.
